Recommended Resources

The recommended readings for this course are freely available online and are as follows:

  • Deep Learning by Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, and Aaron Courville
  • Deep Learning for NLP and Speech Recognition by Uday Kamath, John Liu, and James Whitaker
The second book can only be downloaded for free when connected to the CU network or VPN. It supplements the previous one with more recent neural network approaches and programming tutorials.
